subject: Brightline press coordination — logo use & embargo details
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@brightline.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Press Team <press@brightline.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: press plan and logo usage for tomorrow's announcement

Hi Sofia —

We're planning to do a short announcement tomorrow about our integration with Redwood. PR wants to include the Redwood logo and a single quote from our Head of Product. Can you confirm: 1) whether we can publicly mention Redwood in the announcement and 2) whether we need any pre-approval copy or logo usage constraints under the MSA/order form?

We have a tight embargo window; if there are restrictions we'll need to know asap. Attaching the draft announcement and the logo package we intend to use. Let me know if someone on your side (legal or partnerships) should be looped in.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Myers
Head of Partnerships, Brightline Media
---Attachments: brightline_draft_announce.txt (text), Brightline_Logo-PNGs.zip (zip)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@brightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: press plan and logo usage for tomorrow's announcement

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft and heads-up. Short answer: we generally allow customer reference + logo use for marketing/announcements per the Order Form/MA S A, but there are a few standard constraints and an approval step. I'm looping in Marissa (legal) and Ben (account lead) to confirm any outstanding redlines and to approve the precise logo art/text.

Two specific asks from our side:
- Please send the exact asset you intend to publish (final PNG/SVG) and the final announcement copy. We need to check for any claims that create product implications.
- Please confirm the desired embargo time (date/time) so we can coordinate approvals.

Ben — can you help with a quick approval workflow? Marissa — tagging you for the legal check: we typically require 48 hours for quote approvals, but if you can confirm quicker for this one that would help.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
---Attachments: brightline_draft_announce.txt (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: press plan and logo usage for tomorrow's announcement

Sofia / Ben —

I've reviewed Brightline's draft. High-level: the MSA (section 6.3 Publicity & References) grants both parties a license to use each other's name/logo for announcements, subject to (a) not implying endorsement beyond the stated integration, and (b) prior approval of attribution/quote if the customer requests. Relevant notes and proposed redlines:

- Logo: Acceptable with our brand guidelines attached. Must use the official Redwood logo (color or white) and respect clearspace. Do NOT modify or animate without written consent.
- Quote approval: We require approval of any Redwood-attributed quote. We can provide one approved quote (up to 60 words) within 24 hours if needed for time-sensitive launches.
- Embargo: We can honor the requested embargo if Brightline confirms a publication time; however, Marketing must receive final copy + assets at least 6 hours before publish to do a quick check.
- Confidentiality carveout: If Brightline wants to include any case metrics or usage numbers, those require a separate data-release permission per the Order Form (Schedule A).

I attached: 1) proposed minimal redline to the publicity paragraph to make the approval window explicit, 2) Redwood brand guidelines excerpt, 3) a short approved quote suggestion.

If the customer agrees to these, legal sign-off is trivial. If they insist on no-approval-for-quote, we should decline.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
---Attachments: Redwood_publicity_redline_v1.pdf, Redwood_brand_guidelines_excerpt.pdf, Redwood_approved_quote.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@brightline.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: press plan and logo usage for tomorrow's announcement

Jordan —

Thanks for the patience while Legal reviewed. Summary and ask:
1) Redwood is happy to be named and to provide a logo. We attach our approved press blurb and the logo files.
2) We need Brightline to: provide final announcement copy + the exact assets you will publish, and agree to the quote-approval step. Per Marissa we can commit to providing an approved quote within 24 hours (we can do faster — aim for 6 hours for this one).
3) Embargo: name the exact embargo time. Our Marketing needs the final copy + assets at least 6 hours prior for a quick consistency check.

Attached: Redwood_approved_press_text_v1.docx, Redwood_logo_pack.zip. Also attaching the OrderForm-Brightline-2026.pdf to show the publicity paragraph in context.

If that's all good, we'll send the signed logo permission and you can proceed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---Attachments: Redwood_approved_press_text_v1.docx, Redwood_logo_pack.zip, OrderForm-Brightline-2026.pdf

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Myers <jordan@brightline.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: press plan and logo usage for tomorrow's announcement

Hi all —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Brightline agrees to the approval flow and to provide final assets. Updated plan: publish on Tue 2026-08-25 at 08:00 PT (embargo lift). We will send final copy and a high-res PNG/SVG by EOD today (attached is a temp headline image). We do not intend to include any usage metrics in the announce.

We confirm we accept the 6-hour window for Redwood Marketing to check final output and the quote approval step (please send the approved quote if possible).

Attaching: brightline_final_headline_image.png (png) — final assets to follow.

Thanks —
Sam Lee
Communications Manager, Brightline Media
---Attachments: brightline_final_headline_image.png (png)
